tasks.title: Question 1
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.
tasks.promptText:
Read this email from your English-speaking friend Sandy and the notes you have made.

Write your email to Sandy using all the notes.

tasks.title: Question 2
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.
tasks.promptText:
You see this notice on an English-language website.
Articles wanted
FILMS
What kind of films do you enjoy?
Do you prefer watching them at the cinema or at home? Why?
Write an article answering these questions and we will put it on our website!
Write your article.

tasks.title: Question 3
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.
tasks.promptText:
Your English teacher has asked you to write a story.
Your story must begin with this sentence.
As the plane flew lower, Lou saw the golden beaches of the island below.
Write your story.
